source.author: verg
source.text: At procul ex celso miratus vertice montis adventum sociasque rates occurrit Acestes, horridus in iaculis et pelle Libystidis ursae, Troïa Criniso conceptum flumine mater quem genuit: veterum non immemor ille parentum gratatur reduces, et gaza laetus agresti excipit, ac fessos opibus solatur amicis.
source.text_original: At procul ex celso miratus vertice montis / adventum sociasque rates occurrit Acestes, / horridus in iaculis et pelle Libystidis ursae, / Troïa Criniso conceptum flumine mater / quem genuit: veterum non immemor ille parentum / gratatur reduces, et gaza laetus agresti / excipit, ac fessos opibus solatur amicis.
source.text_english: But from afar, from the high peak of the mountain, Acestes, marveling at their coming and the allied ships, comes forth, shaggy with spears and the hide of a Libyan bear, he whom his mother, of Trojan stock, conceived by the river Crinisus and bore: mindful not of his ancient forebears, he rejoices in the return of his kin, and gladly receives them with rustic wealth, and comforts the weary with friendly bounty.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: Ecce per obliqui rapidum compendia montis ductor avens laetusque dolis agnoscit Acastum horrentem iaculis et parmae luce coruscum.
reuse.text_original: Ecce per obliqui rapidum compendia montis / ductor avens laetusque dolis agnoscit Acastum / horrentem iaculis et parmae luce coruscum.
reuse.text_english: Look, by the steep shortcuts of the slanting mountain, the leader, eager and glad at the stratagem, recognizes Acastus, bristling with spears and flashing with the sheen of his round shield.
